content.title: Library: Add token override to usersRegenerate
content.description: Chore deliverable — add a backward-compatible programmatic auth override to usersRegenerate so the webapp can forward an authenticated user's token. The CTO's review (mqe1imi4lg) recommends usersRegenerate(name, { token }) forwarding into resolveAuthor. This is the provider side of the cross-team fix for BUG-1 (parent epic mqe162cmbi).

content.content: Status loop: all phase tasks done (Design, Review, Verify-agreed gate, Implement, Validate, Release). The backward-compatible token override for usersRegenerate is delivered and released. Marking this sub-deliverable done; parent epic mqe162cmbi will cascade once its sibling webapp bug mqe26n00jo also completes.
